name: Éléonore Caroit
role: Minister Delegate for Francophonie, International Partnerships and French Nationals Abroad
bio: Éléonore Anne-Marie Caroit (born 8 July 1985 in Paris) is a French lawyer and politician of Franco-Dominican heritage who also holds Swiss and Dominican citizenship. A member of Renaissance (RE), she practised for over a decade as an international lawyer specialising in litigation and arbitration in Latin America, admitted to the bars of Paris, New York and Geneva. She was elected deputy for the 2nd constituency for French residents abroad (Latin America and the Caribbean) in 2022, re-elected after a Constitutional Council-ordered re-run in 2023 and again in 2024, and served as vice-president of the National Assembly's Committee on Foreign Affairs. She was appointed Minister-Delegate for Francophonie, International Partnerships and French Nationals Abroad in the government of Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu in October 2025 and retained the post in the February 2026 reshuffle.
